summary: Keep Walmart and ZIP-aware retailer pricing outside AnyList until a separate verified press exists.
reason: A static search of the local Printing Press library found no Walmart CLI or Walmart press. AnyList exposes PBItemPrice, PBStore, and PBStoreFilter fields as synchronized item/store metadata, while product-lookup is a read-only catalog lookup by barcode; neither provides a ZIP-aware Walmart price or availability query. The current CLI deliberately rejects unverified per-item price/store writes. Do not infer Walmart prices from cached AnyList metadata or invent a retailer handler.
validated_outcome: The CLI documentation and registries now state that AnyList store metadata and barcode catalog lookup are not Walmart/ZIP pricing. No Walmart command or guessed price source was added. A separate Walmart press, accepting a ZIP or store selector and independently verifying price/availability, remains the safe implementation path; no live data changed.
